messages:
Maria Chen: Starting blue->green shift for edge-router: v12 rollout. Window 03:00-03:20 UTC. Steps: 0->10->30->70->100 with 3-5m pauses. deploy-bot: queued job id rb-2026-03-21-1770001234.
deploy-bot: phase 1: set v12 weight 10% -> `routerctl set-weight edge-router v12 10`
ops-sre: I'll watch infra and egress distribution. Kevin, watch p95 and application error-rate.
Kevin O'Neill: Health thresholds: p95 > 450ms OR user-error-rate > 1% triggers stop. Currently p95=180ms, errors=0.09%.
deploy-bot: phase 1 complete. v12=10%. Observability: https://console/redwood/obs/route/edge-router?range=5m
Lina Gomez: Seeing a couple of 504s in us-west2 (2->6) right after phase 1, investigating client side timeouts.
ops-sre: Confirmed spike pinned to a single ASG in us-west2. Restarted node; 504s back to baseline.
Maria Chen: After the node restart and 5m stable, proceed to 30%.
deploy-bot: phase 2: set v12 weight 30% -> `routerctl set-weight edge-router v12 30`
Kevin O'Neill: p95=220ms, errors=0.17%. No alerts. Proceed to 70% after 5m.
Oliver Patel: Note: I pushed a session affinity tweak earlier; TTL is 45s. Flagging in case we see session mismatch.
deploy-bot: phase 3: set v12 weight 70% (grace=20s)
ops-sre: Watching tail latency and NAT throughput for regions. All regions look stable.
deploy-bot: phase 3 complete. v12=70%. Metrics: p95=260ms, errors=0.24%.
Kevin O'Neill: Slight p95 bump in ap-south (300ms) but under threshold. No rollback. Proceed to final cut.
deploy-bot: final cut: set v12 weight 100% -> `routerctl set-weight edge-router v12 100 --drain-old=90s`
deploy-bot: final cut complete, v12=100%. Time elapsed ~12m.
Maria Chen: Confirming old pool drained and metrics stable. Will file release notes and tag changelog. If anyone saw anomalies please add a note here.
Lina Gomez: Captured traces for the us-west2 spike: https://console/redwood/traces/trace-xyz. Looks like a transient backend GC.
Kevin O'Neill: Closing window. No rollback. Nice and clean. :white_check_mark:
Maria Chen: Closing thread and filing release note. Thanks team.
